wire.t: Asian Jim made a Friday-morning waiver move at running back. Earlier in the week Bill_Buttlicker dropped Tyquan Thornton and Isaiah Davis and TheMoneyTeam2302 picked up DeMario Douglas.

Bill_Buttlicker dropped Tyquan Thornton and Isaiah Davis, and TheMoneyTeam2302 picked up DeMario Douglas. Asian Jim swapped Christian Kirk for Jaydon Blue, and Bourbon Lover swapped Jalen Royals for Devin Singletary.

The Champ traded Tanner McKee to Hold My DK for six fourth-round picks and a 2029 third. Hold My DK then dropped Jalon Daniels, and TheMoneyTeam2302 now owns no picks in the first four rounds of 2027, 2028 or 2029.

Week 8 byes are Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco. That takes Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle away from Hold My DK against LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, and Brock Purdy off the board for Catfan94’s Farm Team.

Lamar Jackson is still out with an ankle injury and Tyler Huntley is starting for Baltimore. Jackson belongs to The Champ, who also has Davante Adams on IR with a ruptured hamstring and a 6-10 week timeline from Sean McVay.
Breece Hall (quad) missed Week 7 for the fourth straight game, but Week 8 is a realistic return target. Terry McLaurin (torn patellar tendon) is done for the season. Both are on Catfan94’s Farm Team.
Jaylen Waddle is questionable after getting hurt in a fall against Arizona, and Mike Evans (Achilles) is week to week. Both belong to Jefferson’s Reserve.
Aaron Jones hurt his knee in Minnesota's Week 7 win and is questionable, with more imaging planned. Jordan Mason scored 8.3 in the lineup for Bourbon Lover. Jones had 2.6.

stories.title: Thursday night is in the books and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads Hold My DK 27.52 to 23.90

body: Week 8 has its first scores. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads Hold My DK 27.52 to 23.90 in the matchup everybody circled, with the unbeaten record and the line at LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix by 9.5 still hanging over it. Plenty of lineup left, and McCaffrey and Kittle are still on the 49ers' bye for Hold My DK.

Elsewhere, Kraft for Cash has 41.96 against Jefferson’s Reserve at 0.00, and The Champ has 40.6 against Bourbon Lover at 0.00. Catfan94’s Farm Team has 14.8 against I Chase Brown Kids at 0.00. Every other team is still waiting on Sunday.

On the waiver wire, Asian Jim made a Friday-morning move at the running back spot, a roster churn on a 2-5 team. StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte (Bill_Buttlicker) has nothing on the board yet, which is also the best Bill_Buttlicker's team has looked all year.
Standings are unchanged from Thursday: Hold My DK 7-0, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix 6-1, Kraft for Cash 5-2. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is still 0-7. Lines are in the Lines tab.

stories.dek: TheMoneyTeam2302 beat Catfan94’s Farm Team 149.60 to 139.58 and owns zero picks in the first four rounds of the next three drafts.
body: Hold My DK beat Catfan94’s Farm Team 149.60 to 139.58 to go 7-0. Caleb Williams had 26.62, Christian McCaffrey had 21.0 and Jaylen Warren had 19.2. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat OBJAY 167.08 to 148.76 and is 6-1 with the best all-play in the league at 63-14.

Kraft for Cash beat The Champ 131.42 to 113.32 once CeeDee Lamb finished with 23.4 on Monday night. Bourbon Lover got Dak Prescott's 29.78 to beat Asian Jim 122.46 to 119.04, and Jefferson’s Reserve beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 116.42 to 82.18. I Chase Brown Kids beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 110.94 to 98.64 with Javonte Williams at 25.0.
The lowest score was Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 82.18. The bad beat was OBJAY: 148.76 and a loss, the highest losing score of the week.

Week 8 is the real test. Hold My DK plays LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, and McCaffrey and Kittle both have the 49ers' bye. Drake London is questionable too. The line has LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix by 9.5.

stories.title: The Champ left 78.5 points on the bench and lost by 18.10
stories.dek: Tony Pollard had 37.0 on the bench. TJohn91 started Nico Collins for 1.6.
body: Kraft for Cash beat The Champ 131.42 to 113.32. Tony Pollard had 37.0, Colston Loveland had 21.4 and Josh Jacobs had 20.1, and all three sat. That's 78.5 points, which is more than the 18.10 it lost by.
The lineup that played had Nico Collins at 1.6, Garrett Wilson at 4.1 and Sam LaPorta at 3.3. Matthew Golden had 7.4. Bucky Irving gave it 26.5 and Matthew Stafford had 23.5.
It's 4-3 now with a 50-27 all-play, which says this team is still good and just keeps losing the close ones. Davante Adams is on IR with a 6-10 week timeline, and Lamar Jackson is still out.
Week 8 is Bourbon Lover and a 39.5-point spread. Houston's bye takes Collins away, but the bench doesn't need him.

stories.title: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is 2‑5 with 12 first-round picks, and Makai Lemon sat on 17.7
stories.dek: Bill_Buttlicker lost 110.94 to 98.64 with Javonte Williams and Drake Maye both putting up big numbers on opposite sides.
body: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lost to I Chase Brown Kids 110.94 to 98.64. Drake Maye had 31.94 and Omar Cooper Jr. had 21.0 in the Week 7 lineup, before Cooper headed to OBJAY in Sunday's trade.
Makai Lemon had 17.7 on the bench. Juwan Johnson had 2.2 in the lineup. That's the lineup that Bill_Buttlicker, a man with a website, set.
The picks are still there: five firsts in 2027, four in 2028 and three in 2029. It's 12 total, the most in the league by six. It's also 9-26 all time.

Week 8 is Asian Jim, and the line has StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte as a 16.0-point underdog. Houston and New Orleans both have byes, which takes Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz, Devaughn Vele and Juwan Johnson out.

feature.title: Week 7: Hold My DK stays perfect and The Champ benches its own comeback
body: Hold My DK beat Catfan94’s Farm Team 149.60 to 139.58. Caleb Williams had 26.62, Christian McCaffrey had 21.0 and Aaron Rodgers had 15.58 in the superflex. Three of its seven wins have come by 10.02 or less.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix had the top score again, 167.08 over OBJAY. Malik Willis had 34.02 and Jameson Williams had 24.6. Michael Penix Jr. had 26.42 on the bench. OBJAY's 148.76 was the highest losing score of the week, with Bo Nix at 32.28 and Geno Smith at 29.98.
Jefferson’s Reserve beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 116.42 to 82.18, the biggest margin of the week at 34.24. Dude, Your Getting a Dell's 82.18 was also the lowest score of Week 7. Br0phy is 0-7.

And Kraft for Cash beat The Champ 131.42 to 113.32 with 78.5 sitting on The Champ's bench, Bourbon Lover beat Asian Jim 122.46 to 119.04 with Dak Prescott's 29.78 on Monday night, and I Chase Brown Kids beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 110.94 to 98.64.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker has 12 firsts and a 2‑5 team. Start the guy who scores.
columns.dek: Makai Lemon had 17.7 on the bench. Juwan Johnson had 2.2 in the lineup. That's a coaching problem.
body: I'm going to say this plainly. Makai Lemon had 17.7 on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte's bench in Week 7. Juwan Johnson had 2.2 in the lineup. The final was 110.94 to 98.64. Do the subtraction.
Bill_Buttlicker is 2-5 with a 19-58 all-play, which is the second-worst in the league. He owns 12 first-round picks and the picks aren't helping this Sunday.
Drake Maye had 31.94. Omar Cooper Jr. had 21.0, and then he went to OBJAY. That's two guys carrying a roster. The rest scored like they were saving it for someone else.
Start the guys who score. That's the whole job. The picks will be fine.

columns.title: 5 waiver rules from Holden McGroin, who has never been told no
columns.dek: Everyone's adding and dropping. I'm here to help.
body: 1. Drop two players and add nobody. Bill_Buttlicker did it this week. An empty roster spot is just a chance waiting to happen.
2. Add a tight end when you need a running back. The Champ added Mason Taylor and cut Ray Davis. Variety is the spice of a 4-3 record.
3. Pick up whoever's name you recognize. Elijah Mitchell has a name. OBJAY has a name for him now.
4. Never wait for waivers to clear. Free agency is the same thing but with more confidence.
5. If it's Thursday and you've scored 0.00, you're still tied for first. Say that out loud.

columns.title: Hold My DK has 1.45 more wins than it should. That's the luckiest thing in the league.
columns.dek: All-play says 5.55 wins. The standings say 7.
body: Hold My DK is 7-0 with a 61-16 all-play. That's 79.2 percent of all possible wins, and in a 7-game season it works out to 5.55 expected wins. TheMoneyTeam2302 has 7, so 1.45 wins of luck. That's the most in the league.

Catfan94’s Farm Team is the other side. It's 57-20 all-play, 5.18 expected wins, and has 4. That's 1.18 wins of bad luck, tied with Asian Jim for the worst in the league. Catfan94’s Farm Team has the third-best all-play and the fourth-best record.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 63-14 and has 6 wins against 5.73 expected, 0.27 over. That's the smallest gap among the contenders, which means it's both good and honest. I don't trust it either.
Week 8 is Hold My DK against LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. My model says the 1.45 comes due. My model also says the 49ers' bye is worth minus 4 points. My model was built on Tuesday.
